URL shortener review: forty-five minutes on gRPC vs REST.

Nobody had redirects/sec, row size, or read:write on the board.

Napkin math first: ~100K seconds/day, peak QPS, storage with replication. Wrong exponent beats wrong service name.

The post walks URL shortener + payment sizing and mistakes I still make — peak multiplier, counting browser QPS but not fan-out.
